review_context.method: The independent reviewer first verified and read the original pinned PDF, then all three new catalogues, the whole updated 7.2 catalogue, 85 integer cases, 11 profiles, seven PDT effects, eight stale direct effects and the two canonical C1514 members. Actual literal bytes and every negative/control contrast were independently checked before compiler observations.
review_context.initial_result: Two blocking findings, B009-F1 and B009-F2.
review_context.correction_adjudication: The coordinator reproduced the counterexamples, repaired the generator and oracle descriptions, added nine corpus regressions, independently checked the new identifier bound and collected fresh observations. These integration corrections are not represented as a second fresh-context review.

source.numbered_ownership: R704-R706/C717 remain owned by 7.4.1; R707-R712/C718-C720 by 7.4.3.1. Previously indexed numbered units are not counted again as newly accounted base units. Canonical expression, operation, allocation, assignment, association and SELECT TYPE dependencies are not claimed as completed catalogues.

7.4.1.rationale: Intrinsic taxonomy, every grammar alternative, default-integer KIND parameter type and the separate sign/support conditions retain their source premises. The selected-expression-kind control now has a sufficient independent conversion bound, while positional/keyword controls remain unconditional. All declaration negatives require case-specific grammar or actual type/value support causes. One canonical expression-category evidence facet remains pending.

7.4.2.rationale: All source items preserve the numeric, relational, concatenation and logical operation references without importing operation semantics or manufacturing a local executable requirement.

7.4.3.1.rationale: Representation, zero, mandatory range-18 capacity, default range-five guarantee, signed denotation, suffix kind and decimal interpretation remain separate requirements. Literal/profile boundaries were reconstructed independently. All negative gates now distinguish their actual grammar, name/type or unsupported-value premise from generic kind nouns, magnitude failures and parser recovery. Three value-set/inventory evidence facets remain pending.

7.2.rationale: All source units and the six new PDT mechanisms were independently checked. The programs use real deferred/assumed PDT LEN parameters, established allocation/association, matching KIND values, alive targets, initialized components and guarded shape/parameter inquiries. Existing eight CHARACTER sources are byte-unchanged but have new requirement fingerprints. The whole-catalogue binding requires a new source review and readjudication of the unchanged finite canonical link.

identifier_conversion_repair.original_defect: A range-18-selected integer method need not represent an arbitrarily large default-integer KIND identifier. Neither a small current identifier nor successful reference execution supplies that missing premise.
identifier_conversion_repair.counterexample: A default binary127 method can have identifier 100000000000000000000 while SELECTED_INT_KIND(18) returns binary63 method 1. The old conversion of the default identifier into method 1 is not representable.
identifier_conversion_repair.repair: Keep default-integer positional/keyword constant-expression controls unconditional. Put the selected-representation expression in a separate case qualified by the existing integer-literal-kind-code-decimal10 profile. Ten integer divisions establish KIND(0) < 10**10 without narrowing it; this bound is strictly inside the mandatory range-18 integer method.
identifier_conversion_repair.limits: The bound is a conservative finite witness, not a universal maximum identifier or proof of distinct kinds. A larger identifier can skip only this optional witness. Mandatory integer capacity remains independently tested without an optional profile.

diagnostic_gate_repair.original_defect: Generic kind, parameter, constant and exponent substrings admitted independently demonstrated wrong causes despite correct source-point binding. Four actual target C717 passes were constancy complaints about already-constant expressions.
diagnostic_gate_repair.repair: Generate per-case grammar/name/type predicates and per-type/per-value support predicates. Preserve exact points and implementation/crash/verifier/resource/echo exclusions. Unsupported representation-value reports remain eligible where support is the intended condition; unsupported language facilities do not.
diagnostic_gate_repair.source_inputs_preserved: All 20 invalid/control source pairs are unchanged. Only the R706 positive witness was split and qualified.
diagnostic_gate_repair.reference_reason: GNU's generic missing-kind-parameter reports do not distinguish the already-present name's type, constancy or negative value. Flang's unrelated assignment/DO recovery does not identify the malformed exponent. Other current references supply the declared causal observations.
diagnostic_gate_repair.regressions: Nine corpus tests cover all 20 wrong-cause contracts and positive diagnostic sets, the four actual constancy fallbacks, source/implementation failure gates, the qualified conversion, mandatory capacity, independent literal limits/zero-prefix lengths and one-source-line repairs.
diagnostic_gate_repair.wording_limit: These are qualified observed reporting routes, not standard-mandated message wording or fatal rejection.

pdt_effects.source_validity: The same host PDT definition and constant KIND argument establish matching declared types. Deferred parameters are queried only after allocation or association; ordinary assumed LEN derives from the effective argument or selector. Targets remain alive and defined, with allocation/association/shape checks before payload access.
pdt_effects.execution: GNU executes all seven effect programs successfully. The frozen target lacks their PDT LEN support, while Flang aborts in PDT lowering. Those are failed observations, not reasons to replace PDTs with CHARACTER controls or downgrade the declared run phase.
pdt_effects.finite_limit: The seven programs do not exercise zero-LEN transitions or every polymorphic, component, array and function-result path. Five source/use-graph facets remain explicitly pending in 7.2; later canonical owners retain their own accounting.

canonical_link.source_connection: The independently reread two scalar default-kind CHARACTER specifics differ only in LEN and fail C1514 distinguishability; the sole rank-one repair supplies a distinction.
canonical_link.input_status: Both member inputs, requirement fingerprints and direct fixture adjudications remain unchanged. The changed whole-7.2 catalogue/source-review binding nevertheless stales the semantic link.
canonical_link.workflow: Refresh the whole-7.2 source review and affected direct fixture reviews, then record the independently confirmed finite semantic connection under its new dependency fingerprint.
canonical_link.limits: One link, no duplicate execution, no universal generic-resolution claim and no computed observed/passing linked aggregate.

observation_snapshot.mode_limit: A passing f2018 observation does not by itself corroborate a case requiring f2023.
